name: Recital 13
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on the welfare of dogs and cats and their traceability
part_text: (13) Directive 2010/63/EU of the European Parliament and of the Council4 regulates the keeping, breeding and supply of animals kept for scientific purposes including dogs and cats. That Directive sets out the final goal of the ‘full replacement of procedures on live animals’ and underlines that the use of animals for such purposes should only be considered where a non-animal method is still unavailable. Where such practices continue, any dogs and cats intended for scientific purposes should nevertheless benefit from at least equal standards of welfare as applied in this Regulation, and the legislation covering their welfare should be updated accordingly. \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ 4 Directive 2010/63/EU of the European Parliament and of the Council of 22 September 2010 on the protection of animals used for scientific purposes (OJ L 276, 20.10.2010, p. 33).
